The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] '''Council''' served as a governmental meeting place for [[Nothoiin Colony]] representatives, who made decisions affecting the [[Near-Human]] [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiin]] civilization. Council was located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and neighbored the [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin homeworld]] along the [[Nothoiin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].

==Description==
Council was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Council system/Legends|Council system]] of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], within the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion<ref name="Atlas" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It sat along the [[Nothoiin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], amidst the sprawling [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]], and neighbored both the planet [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]] and the decayed [[Black dwarf/Legends|black dwarf]] [[Dwarf star/Legends|star]] known locally as "[[The Ring/Legends|the Ring]]."<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==History==
Council lay nestled among the vast [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]] [[Nebula/Legends|gas clouds]] of [[Kiax Nebula/Legends|Kiax]] and Ivax. Left over from the Ring's [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] eons before, the Twin Nebulae dominated the Greater Javin and long prevented [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] from easily reaching surrounding planets like Council that were not part of the centralized [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] running through the region. In particular, these scouts sought an efficient route to the planet Nothoiin, [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Color/Legends|gold]]-skinned [[Near-Human]]s known as [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiin]], who were ripe for [[Merchant/Legends|trade]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

After [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of failed attempts, the entrepreneur [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] finally found purchase through the gas clouds on either side of the Corellian Trade Spine in the [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The new Nothoiin Corridor, blazing through the Ivax Nebula, connected the planet Nothoiin and its [[Alien/Legends|alien]] civilization with the Trade Spine by way of Council. Figg's success turned the region into an economic powerhouse.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

Council took its name as a Nothoiin governmental world. [[Nothoiin Colony]] representatives met on the planet's surface to reach decisions regarding their people, though Council's jurisdiction did not extend to non-Nothoiin affairs. Originally part of the Republic's [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]], Council was reorganized into the new Anoat [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> circa [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which is set during the [[Rebellion era|Rebellion]] and [[New Republic era]]s ([[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]&ndash;[[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]; see {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}}), states that the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] was established in the last [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg's]] life. The text states that Figg [[Death/Legends|died]] nearly four [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to its setting, thus providing an approximate date of [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]] for the Anoat [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] establishment.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Council was created for the [[2004]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Wizards.com|online]] article "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />
